mobbin:3ca22a69-3cb8-4993-9cbd-f07f63757.summary: From a Week-by-Area grid, the manager opens Auto, builds shift structure, runs Build shifts, and lands on EMPTY/OPEN slots with one warning.
steps: Week by Area grid with Open and footer
Auto menu: hours, structure, fill empty
Auto Build: lengths, prior schedules, times
Auto Build progress with trivia text
steal: The Auto menu splits three jobs: regular hours, build structure, and fill empty (screen 2), so adoption does not need one opaque AI button.
Auto Build asks for ordered shift lengths, requirements from previous schedules, and a start-at-:00 constraint (screen 3).
A footer status counts empty, published, open and warnings while generation runs (screens 1, 4 to 5).
After the build, EMPTY cards, an OPEN label and a red warning triangle mark cells that still need work (screen 5).
avoid: Trivia during Auto Build progress (screen 4) wastes coordinator attention; a schedule preview would serve better.
mobbin:3ca22a69-3cb8-4993-9cbd-f07f63757.fit: Scheduling: maps to flexi auto-generate of N sessions from prior demand. Keep structure-then-fill plus EMPTY, OPEN and warning labels; extend LearningSpace flexi, not full AI labour planning.

mobbin:6a3f27e2-9c1c-4dbd-a527-d26366020.summary: From an empty Week-by-Area grid with a people sidebar and per-cell plus, the manager drafts grey shifts, then publishes them to green cards with an Open shift.
steps: Empty Week by Area with cell plus
steal: Week by Area puts roles or areas on rows and days on columns, and every empty cell has a plus (screens 1 to 3).
A people sidebar shows Open shifts and each person's hours and cost (screens 1 to 3).
Draft to Publish is explicit: grey unpublished cards become green published ones (screens 2 to 3).
A footer legend explains empty, unpublished, published, open, warnings, leave and unavailable (screens 1 to 3).
mobbin:6a3f27e2-9c1c-4dbd-a527-d26366020.fit: Scheduling: closest room-by-room pattern for Essentials. Areas map to rooms or stations; keep draft/publish and open slots; drop labour-cost if unused.

mobbin:33ce7034-4170-4403-be14-e3b58184a.summary: An employee opens Schedule, picks Can't work then Swap shift, selects a teammate's shift with a message, sends it, and sees SWAP/OPEN labels on the grid.
steps: Week by Area with OPEN Admin slot
Shift details for Sam Lee, Can't work
Can't work: Offer shift or Swap shift
Grid shows SWAP and OPEN labels
steal: Can't work splits Offer versus Swap (screen 4), so staff can open a claim pool or trade with a peer.
The Swap form shows your shift summary, teammate search, selectable peer shifts, a default message and a Send count (screens 5 to 6).
After the request, the grid shows LOCKED, OPEN and SWAP labels (screens 7 to 8).
Me calendar shows who is Scheduled that day with avatars (screen 1).
avoid: Allowing Admin and Manager to swap without an eligibility check (screens 5 to 6) would break faculty and learner role limits in sim.
mobbin:33ce7034-4170-4403-be14-e3b58184a.fit: Scheduling: a pattern for learner or faculty self-serve swap with coordinator visibility via a SWAP label; pair with approval before the calendar commits.
